oneLiner: Film prediction pools where GenLayer validators verify frozen rules and published box-office results. Stake StudioNet GEN and share the winning pot.
description: Bullseye is a film prediction platform for movie fans. Choose an opening-weekend revenue range, stake 2–100 StudioNet GEN, track your prediction, and collect your share of the winning pool. Five upcoming films close before previews; Barbie, Oppenheimer and Dune: Part Two offer historical GEN practice with known results. GenLayer validators independently check the proposed rules and read The Numbers for the exact domestic US/Canada result. The pool consumes that finalized oracle outcome; no administrator enters a winner. Winners share the whole pot proportionally, with no pool fee. Missing evidence stays pending until a fixed deadline permits refunds; an empty winning range also refunds entrants. The app follows confirmation and settlement automatically while a page is open. StudioNet is a development simulator; the daily background keeper awaits its server authentication setting. The public repo includes contracts, signed historical deposit/payout proofs, tests and a tutorial.

howTo.heading: Browse upcoming markets
howTo.instruction: Open the website. Upcoming lists five films with fixed ranges and pre-release cutoffs. Select a Street Fighter range to open its 2 GEN ticket. Expand Market rules & result to inspect the source and timing; no wallet is needed to browse.

howTo.heading: Try an instant result
howTo.instruction: Choose Practice, open Barbie, and expand Play for free points. Select $150m – under $200m and confirm without an exact guess. You should see $162,022,044 and 100 practice points. Reload to check persistence. This does not stake GEN.

howTo.heading: Verify GenLayer execution
howTo.instruction: Open the GitHub README and docs/DEMO.md. Follow the public oracle, film-pool and upcoming-pool manifests. They retain successful finalized specifications, adjudications, callbacks and credited historical transfers. Run npm run test:network and npx tsx scripts/verify-upcoming.ts for read-only checks.

howTo.heading: Optional funded practice
howTo.instruction: Use your own MetaMask/GenLayer-plugin wallet on StudioNet 61999 with at least 2 GEN. Choose Barbie’s $150m – under $200m range in the main GEN ticket, stake 2 GEN and sign. Leave the app open until the shared two-minute session settles; Collect and sign once. GEN received requires an exact credited transfer. Upcoming stakes remain held until their future result or void.

expectedOutcome: The live app shows five upcoming and three historical GEN markets. Barbie free practice returns $162,022,044 and 100 points without an exact guess, surviving reload. Read-only checks verify successful finalized oracle/callback receipts and five matching open pools with unknown outcomes. Retained single-entrant signed proofs show 2 GEN deposits and credited 2 GEN payouts for all three historical films. The optional wallet flow confirms a stake, settles, then verifies native credit.
